> 第十六章 寂灭之力（第1页）
波风冥帝感受到了，他感受到了自己所施展出的千鸟锐枪是何等的锐利。此时波风冥帝伸出另外一只手，查克拉旋转，形成螺旋丸！
“寂灭！”千鸟锐枪的力量，螺旋丸的力量再一次碰撞在了一起！
冥帝想着千鸟锐枪虽然速度快，但还是杀伤力不够！冥帝想要是加入了螺旋丸的力量，没准威力会更加强大了起来。
要成功了！冥帝心里狂喜，眼见得自己就要开创一种威力巨大的合体忍术了，可就在冥帝以为螺旋丸和千鸟锐枪要结合在一起的时候。
顿时查克拉气流凌乱了起来，飞沙走石，烟尘漫天。好在这狂风来得快也去得快，待得一切尘埃落定，冥帝啊的一声张大嘴巴，眼珠子都快瞪到了地上。
只见盘坐在树下休息的照美冥一身灰尘，那末曾除下的斗篷上还沾着几片树叶，当然最要命的还不是这个，而是此时的照美冥罗衫半解，出前胸大片雪白肌肤。
见此情景冥帝差点没晕倒，一方面当然被眼前美妙给刺激的，另一方面是吓的，若是照美冥在此时醒来，他这罪魁祸首就完蛋了。
冥帝胆颤心惊了半响，开始冷静下来，事于至此，还是想着怎么补救吧。要不一不做二不休将她得了？冥帝脑海中突然冒出一个邪恶的想法，但很快就被他坚定的意志给压了下去，自己还太小，是小孩子，可能满足不了水影，照美冥！
但是冥帝也不是什么正人君子，他一边蹑手蹑脚地朝照美冥走去，一边咽着口水欣赏着照美冥。不看白不看，傻子才不看。
轻轻走到照美冥的身边蹲下来，冥帝就想替着照美冥整理好衣服。。
“千万别醒过来，千万别醒过来。”
“你的脚没事吧，我帮你看看。”冥帝碰了照美冥的肩膀，声音变得很温柔。
“不要你管，你这个混蛋，妄我这么信任你，你却对我做出这种事。”照美冥用力拍开冥帝的手，此时的她整一受了委屈的小女孩，她都忘了她可是水之国的水影照美冥，拥有溶遁，沸遁的天才忍者。
“冤枉啊，我可什么都没做。刚刚一阵狂风刮来，将你的衣服吹开了。天地良心，我只是想将你的衣服整理好，免得你醒来尴尬啊，谁知你正好就那时醒了过来。”冥帝解释道，只是他可不敢说那狂风是他施放出来的忍术造成的。
“鬼才相信你。”冥帝继续哽咽着，其实听完了冥帝的解释，照美冥下意识地就相信了，因为她刚刚也发现自己衣服上一身的灰尘，但是现在她除了埋住脑袋之外也没其它办法，经过如此尴尬的事情，她都不知道应该怎么面对冥帝，也只有继续沉闷了。
“哎，别哭了，我帮你揉揉。”冥帝被照美冥这样子弄得有些心烦意乱，不由分说便抓起她的右脚，有些粗鲁的褪去她的鞋袜。一只雪白晶莹的玉足便呈面在冥帝的眼前，五趾小而精巧，由于骤不及防而害羞地卷曲着这水影照美冥不会天天用玫瑰花泡脚吧，照美冥心里嘀咕着。
“干什么？放手，快放手啊。”照美冥用发颤的手推着冥帝，脸色一阵青一阵红，似害羞似震怒又似紧张！
“什么干什么？没看到我正给你看脚吗？别乱动。”冥帝看到这么美的纤足上在脚踝处竟红肿了大片正心疼呢，见得照美冥推他不由抬头瞪了她一眼。欢迎广大书友光临阅读，最新、最快、最火的连载作品尽在！

> Chapter 16 The Power of Annihilation (Page 1)
Namikaze Hades felt it, and he felt how sharp the Chidori Spear he used was. At this time, Namikaze Hades stretched out his other hand, and the chakra rotated to form a Rasengan!
"Nirvana!" The power of the Chidori Spear and the power of the Rasengan collided together again!
Emperor Hades thought that although the Chidori Spear was fast, it was still not lethal enough! Hades thought that if he added the power of the Rasengan, it might become even more powerful.
It's going to work! Emperor Hades was ecstatic, seeing that he was about to create a powerful combined ninjutsu, but just when Emperor Hades thought that the Rasengan and the Chidori Spear were going to be combined.
Suddenly the chakra flow became chaotic, sand and rocks flew, and smoke filled the sky. Fortunately, the strong wind came and went quickly. When everything settled, Emperor Hades opened his mouth wide with a cry, and his eyes nearly hit the ground.
Terumi Mei was seen sitting cross-legged and resting under the tree, covered in dust, and the cloak she had taken off was still stained with a few leaves. Of course, the most terrible thing was not this, but that Terumi Mei's shirt was half unbuttoned, and a large area of ​​snow-white skin was exposed on her chest.
Seeing this scene, Hades Emperor almost fainted. On the one hand, he was of course stimulated by the beauty in front of him, and on the other hand, he was frightened. If Terumi Mei woke up at this time, he, the culprit, would be finished.
Emperor Hades was frightened for a while and began to calm down. At this point, he still thought about how to remedy the situation. Or do you want to get her if you don't do anything else? An evil thought suddenly appeared in Ming Emperor's mind, but it was quickly suppressed by his firm will. He was still too young and a child, so he might not be able to satisfy Mizukage and Terumi Mei!
But Emperor Ming was not a gentleman either. He tiptoed towards Terumi Mei while swallowing his saliva and admiring Terumi Mei. If you don’t see it, it’s in vain. You’re a fool who doesn’t see it.
After gently walking to Terumi Mei's side and squatting down, Hades wanted to help Terumi Mei tidy up her clothes. .
"Don't wake up, don't wake up."
"Is your foot okay? Let me check for you." Emperor Ming touched Terumi Mei's shoulder and his voice became very gentle.
"Don't worry about it, you bastard. I don't think I trust you so much, but you do this to me." Terumi Mei forcefully slapped Ming Emperor's hand away. At this time, she was a completely wronged little girl. She had forgotten that she was Terumi Mei, the Mizukage of the Kingdom of Water, a genius ninja with Melting Release and Boiling Release.
"It's unfair, I didn't do anything. A strong wind just blew and blew your clothes away. I just want to put your clothes in order to prevent you from being embarrassed when you wake up. Who would have thought that you woke up at that time." Hades explained, but he did not dare to say that the strong wind was caused by the ninjutsu he cast.
"Only a ghost believes you." Emperor Hades continued to choke. In fact, after hearing Emperor Hades' explanation, Terumi Mei subconsciously believed it because she had just noticed the dust on her clothes, but now she had no other choice but to bury her head. After such an embarrassing incident, she didn't know how to face Emperor Hades, so she could only continue to be depressed.
"Hey, stop crying, I'll rub it for you." Emperor Ming was a little upset by Terumi Mei's behavior, so he grabbed her right foot without any explanation and roughly took off her shoes and socks. A snow-white and crystal jade foot appeared in front of Hades' eyes. The five toes were small and delicate, and curled up shyly due to the sudden surprise. Terumi Mei, the water shadow, wouldn't soak her feet with roses every day, Terumi Mei murmured in her heart.
"What are you doing? Let go, let go quickly." Terumi Mei pushed Ming Emperor with trembling hands, her face turned blue and red, as if she was shy, angry and nervous!
"What are you doing? Didn't you see that I was showing you your feet? Don't move." Ming MingEmperor felt distressed when he saw such beautiful slender feet with large areas of redness and swelling at the ankles.
